config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-06: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — ViewDefinition.select.forEach; ViewDefinition.select.forEachOrNull. Test these items: forEach 0..1 FHIRPath expression selects parent elements for the containing select; forEach multiplies rows for each item in the selected collection; forEach suppresses rows when the collection is empty; forEachOrNull preserves one row with null nested values when the collection is empty; nested columns are evaluated relative to each iterated item; built-in ViewDefinition/FHIRPath variables remain correct in iterated contexts, including %context, %resource, %rootResource, and %rowIndex. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.
